A '''tradition''' of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|people sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was developed by the [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]], after they joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] at some point between [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] and [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The organization had several members in 25 ABY and was taught on Omwat.
